summary: Iteration 10 (subject=colore / vtracer colour tracing engine): 5/5 new backend tests PASS in ~3.7s hitting the public preview URL, plus a full regression run of 36/36 across every prior vectorize suite (iter5-iter9) also PASS in ~27s. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_vectorize_color_mode.py. Verified: (1) POST /api/vectorize with subject=colore on a synthetic multi-colour emblem (blue quadrants + red badge + black 'M' text + black outer ring) returns HTTP 200 with count>0, width_mm>0, height_mm>0, and both preview_url + dxf_url populated; every returned polyline has >=3 points. (2) The preview_url resolves via /api/files/{path} to a real RGB PNG (validated magic bytes 89 50 4E 47 and re-decoded successfully with OpenCV) — this is the rendered vtracer colour SVG rasterised through cairosvg (server.py:801, vectorize.py:388-391). (3) The dxf_url resolves to a valid DXF (contains 'SECTION' header in the first 2KB). (4) REGRESSION subject=scritta on black 'EVA' text on white returns 200 with count>0 and populated polylines. (5) REGRESSION subject=logo on a dark diamond shape on a noisy light background returns 200 with count>0 (auto-circle correctly did NOT fire because shape is a diamond, so it went through the threshold/potrace path). (6) REGRESSION subject=cerchio on a filled black circle returns exactly the 96-point circle polyline expected from _circle_poly(n=96). No new bugs found. Backend logs show the /api/vectorize?subject=colore calls returning 200 cleanly with the vtracer pipeline invoked. vtracer + cairosvg imports both succeed at backend startup. Frontend testing skipped per request.
critical_code_review_comments: vectorize.py:237-266 (_vtracer_svg): correctly writes the BGR image to a temp PNG (OpenCV imwrite handles BGR->PNG conversion), invokes vtracer.convert_image_to_svg_py with sensible tuning (speckle scaled to 2% of min dim, color_precision=6, layer_difference=24, hierarchical='stacked', mode='spline'), reads the SVG back, and cleans up BOTH tmp files in a finally block. Silent None fallback if vtracer missing — server.py then re-raises ValueError 'Motore colore non disponibile' as HTTP 422 which is correct.

vectorize.py:269-290 (_svg_to_polys_px): extracts every 'd=' attribute via regex and samples each continuous subpath into pixel-space polylines with adaptive sampling (24..400 pts based on subpath length/2). Y stays in image orientation (top-down), consistent with the rest of the module.

vectorize.py:366-391 (colore branch): correctly filters out the full-frame background region using the same (cw>0.985*w AND ch>0.985*h) OR area>0.92*img_area heuristic used elsewhere. Renders the SVG to a PNG preview via cairosvg at the exact w x h of the processed image so front-end can overlay it precisely.
vectorize.py:325-328: presets['colore'] has smooth_it=0 (correct — vtracer already emits smooth splines, Chaikin would over-round them) and min_area_frac=0.001 (matches iter6 defaults for logo).

server.py:767-812 (/api/vectorize): correctly serialises the ValueError('Motore colore non disponibile') from vtracer-missing to a 422 with the Italian message. preview_url and dxf_url use file_url() -> /api/files/{path} which the /api/files streaming route serves with appropriate Content-Disposition attachment for png/dxf downloads.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 iter10 colour-mode; 36/36 full vectorize regression across iter5-iter10)

seed_data_creation: None — every test posts synthetic images and inspects the response; the /api/vectorize route stores preview/dxf outputs under storage prefix 'boat-mat/vectorize/{uuid}' but does not touch MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rerun with: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_vectorize_color_mode.py -v`. The five iter10 factories exercise the colour engine: _multicolour_logo (BMW-ish: black outer ring, blue ellipse quadrants, red bottom badge, bold black 'M' — must yield count>0 through vtracer color mode), _black_text_on_white (subject=scritta regression), _dark_shape_on_light (subject=logo on non-circular shape so auto-circle does NOT fire — noisy 225-250 background prevents _crop_letterbox from stripping margins), _filled_circle (subject=cerchio -> exactly one 96-pt _circle_poly). Preview and DXF URLs are relative paths of the form '/api/files/...'; prefix with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to fetch. vtracer and cairosvg are Python packages already installed in the backend venv (verified with `python -c 'import vtracer; import cairosvg'`).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Main agent's earlier BMW-photo smoke test (count~99) matches the design; on cleaner synthetic imagery vtracer returns a smaller but non-zero count as expected, and all URLs are downloadable.
